result:
Admins can now rename their team from the profile page. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been run or type-checked.

- **API:** `features/teams/api/update-team.ts` is new. It sends `PATCH /teams/{teamId}` with `{ name }`, validated by a Zod schema that rejects empty names. On success it invalidates the teams query so the new name shows up.
- **Rename form:** `features/teams/components/update-team.tsx` is new. It is a "Rename" button that opens a form drawer with a Team Name field. After saving, it shows a "Team Updated" success notification.
- **Team section:** `features/teams/components/team-section.tsx` is new. It shows the current user's team name, looked up from the teams list by `teamId`. The Rename button is wrapped in `<Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}>`, so only admins see it.
- **Profile page:** `app/routes/app/profile.tsx` now renders `<TeamSection />` below the user information.
- **Mock backend:** I added a `PATCH /teams/:teamId` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts`, since the app runs against MSW. It requires an admin and only allows renaming the user's own team. It also persists the change to the mock DB.

I didn't add any tests for the new feature.
